BrochureContent.Content:
This five bedroom detached two storey house is conveniently situated c.1 km from Roscrea town centre and all local amenities. The property stands on an elevated site with side vehicle access and a good size rear garden. The property is in need of some modernisation. The accommodation briefly comprises of an entrance hall, kitchen/dining room, living room. family bathroom and five bedrooms. The property benefits from double glazed uPVC windows, mains services, dual Solid fuel and Oil fired central heating.
Outside there is a secure front garden in lawn and vehicle side access to the rear garden. The rear garden is in lawn and there is a useful cladded storage shed. The property has easy access to the M7 motor way and is close to Ballybrophy train station with commuter links to Dublin each day. 

Viewing of this ideal family home is a must.
